verdict.rationale: macOS ships Spotlight as a built-in launcher that can "search and take action without opening apps," which covers the launcher half of the story. Nothing in the pack documents system-wide hotkeys or full keyboard-only control. Third-party tools (Moom, Keyboard Maestro) and hidutil key remapping are workarounds or adjacent features and earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented global keyboard shortcuts/hotkeys, evidence of keyboard-only navigation of the entire system (Full Keyboard Access, window management via keys), Spotlight launch hotkey details, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can operate the entire system using only the keyboard via hotkeys and a launcher
